comments.body: Nothing will happen to you, you provided the necessary documents from your side. It was the responsibility of the employer to check with AWA. Worst-worst case scenario you will receive a 500 fr fine which happened to my friend in a similar situation but he did not have a valid work permit issued by the uni. So whoever you talk to, just explain everything but without trying too hard on blaming the company/boss.
comments.author: FamousDeer4131
